data.narrative:
Swarm Aero is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $8M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic. The peer set spans Seed through Series A stages, reflecting the early-stage nature of the target.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method uses the $8M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding $20M. The Peer-Median method examines four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M), producing a median of $700M with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneous funding trajectories and technology maturity within the Defense & Security frontier-tech segment.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $17M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $360M. The 47x spread between low and high estimates reflects substantial uncertainty inherent to early-stage, pre-revenue companies in this sector. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation relative to better-capitalized peers, path to initial customer traction, and whether the peer set—dominated by more mature Seed and Series A companies—appropriately benchmarks Swarm Aero's current position.
